producer_report.summary:
An interrupted job (dispatched, no live process, no closing record) can now be retried, and `athena drain` picks it up. The full test suite, clippy and fmt all pass.

Root cause: `earlier_attempt` in reading.rs accepted only Closed(Rejected|Failed) jobs and required a verification or outcome record. It had no notion of "dispatched but no process owns it", which `athena status` and `go` already compute.

What changed:
- **reading.rs:** `earlier_attempt_with(..., running)` is new, and `earlier_attempt` delegates to it with "nothing running". A Dispatched job with no process is accepted without needing a verification or outcome record. A Dispatched job with a live process is refused with "job X is running; wait for it to finish before trying it again". `ask` and `correct` pass the real registry check. The other-state refusal keeps its old wording and appends ", or one that was interrupted". I also added `retried_job`, which reads "try again on <id>".
- **status.rs:** `running` is now public. The interrupted next-step hint now names `athena retry` beside `athena close`.
- **run.rs:** the `go` message for an interrupted job names retry, and `go` reuses `running`.
- **steward.rs:** new `interrupted_work(records, running)`. It lists Dispatched jobs with no process on the drained channels only. It skips a job that a later "try again on <id>" request already names, so one drain does not retry the same job on every run.
- **cli drain.rs:** `Item` has a new `interrupted` flag. `RealSteps::queue` appends interrupted work after reaping dead registry entries. The loop's first attempt for such an item is `ReadOf::Retry`, and the retry job is then run without a second reading. If the retry itself could not be read, the item stays "interrupted" for its second attempt. The planning read-pass skips interrupted items, because it would otherwise call `go` on a dispatched job. Module docs are updated.
- **CHANGELOG.md:** entry added.

Tests:
- **retry.rs:** an interrupted job gets a proposal whose request is "try again on <id>" and whose reader brief carries the original request. A job with a live registered process group is refused with "is running", and nothing is recorded.
- **tests/drain.rs:**
  - A stub test checks the reread-then-run order.
  - A real-records test has an interrupted job on the `cli` channel and one on `web`. Only the `cli` one is listed. The drain retries it, runs it and lands it, with a TargetMet stop and not "queue empty". The `web` job is left Dispatched, and the `cli` job is not listed again afterwards.

The tests build an interrupted job the way lifecycle.rs does: a killed producer, then the history is reset to just before the closing commit.

checks_run.note: ran `cargo fmt --all` first, then clippy and the tests
all suites pass, including the new retry and drain tests. I re-ran with -q to read the output because the plain run was too large to inspect.

criteria_check.criterion: A test (cargo test) makes a job dispatched with no live process, runs retry on it, and gets a proposal whose request is 'try again on <id>' carrying the original request, not the error 'only a rejected or failed job can be tried again'.
criteria_check.evidence: `an_interrupted_job_is_tried_again_with_its_original_request` in crates/athena-cli/tests/retry.rs passes. It checks the new job's request text is `try again on <id>`, the reader brief contains `> remove the readme`, and the interrupted job is left Dispatched.

criteria_check.criterion: A test (cargo test) shows a job whose process is still running is refused by retry with a clear message saying it is running.
criteria_check.evidence: `a_job_that_is_still_running_is_refused_by_retry` in retry.rs passes. It registers a live `sleep` process group for the job in the registry and asserts the error contains 'is running' and the head is unchanged.

criteria_check.criterion: A drain test (cargo test) with an interrupted job on the drained channel shows it listed as work and retried, with no empty-queue report; an interrupted job on another channel is left alone.
criteria_check.evidence: `drain_lists_and_retries_an_interrupted_job_and_leaves_one_on_another_channel_alone` and the stub test `an_interrupted_job_is_retried_first_and_then_run` in crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs pass. The real-records test asserts the queue lists only the `cli` job and flags it interrupted. The drain then ends with TargetMet, one job line, outcome passed, and a retry job whose request is `try again on <id>`. The `web` job stays Dispatched, and the queue is empty afterwards.

criteria_check.criterion: The `athena status` next-step hint for interrupted jobs (status.rs) and the run.rs interrupted message name retry as a way to resume, alongside close.
criteria_check.evidence: Read both edited strings: status.rs gives `athena retry {id}   # reads it again to resume · or: athena close {id} --why ...`, and run.rs says `athena retry {id}` reads it again to resume, or `athena close ...`.

criteria_check.criterion: drain.rs module docs and CHANGELOG.md describe interrupted jobs being retryable and drained.
criteria_check.evidence: crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs has a new module-doc bullet 'An interrupted job is retried' and an amended Retry bullet. CHANGELOG.md has an Unreleased entry.

criteria_check.criterion: cargo test, cargo clippy and cargo fmt --check all pass.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran `cargo fmt --all` then `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`, which was clean. `cargo test --locked -q` showed every suite 'ok' with 0 failed. I did not run `cargo fmt --all --check` as a separate command after the format.

open_issues: Deliverables store.rs and manage.rs were not changed because nothing needed it, and steward.rs was changed though it is not on the list. This is the reason the drain file path in the brief points at a file that does not exist.

The interrupted job is never closed by a retry. If its retry later also fails, the original stays listed as interrupted in `athena status`. A drain will not retry it again, because a retry request names it. It needs a manual `athena close`.
mistakes: `Athena::retry` now has a redundant `registry().reap()` call before `ask`, which already reaps. It is harmless.
learnings: The brief lists crates/athena-core/src/drain.rs, but drain lives in crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs. Queue selection (`queued_work`) is in crates/athena-core/src/steward.rs, so I edited steward.rs and the CLI drain.rs instead of store.rs and manage.rs. Those two needed no change.
The process registry is reached through `Athena::running` in status.rs, and the registry is reaped at the start of `ask`.
`ask` records the channel `cli`, which is a drained channel. A real interrupted job from `athena ask` is therefore on a drained channel.
Tests make an interrupted job by running a job with a killed producer and then resetting the git history to just before the closing commit.
desires: Reading files outside the working directory, such as saved tool output, is blocked, so I re-ran the tests with -q to see results. A way to see long test output would help.
